name: B10-0370/2025 (Verts/ALE) – Situation in Colombia after the wave of recent terrorist attacks
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the situation in Colombia after the wave of recent terrorist attacks
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion on the violence in Colombia. It condemns the recent attacks and the killing of Senator Miguel Uribe Turbay. It asks Colombia to bring those responsible to justice, protect political candidates and human rights and environmental defenders, and speed up the 2016 peace agreement. It also asks the European Union to keep funding and supporting that peace process.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; this is a statement of position and requests.
- **Who it affects:** Colombia's government, peace process, and people at risk, such as defenders and candidates.
- **What happens next:** The text goes to EU institutions and Colombia's government and congress; EU support and funding are urged.
